subcommands.name: batch-create-table-rows
subcommands.description: The BatchCreateTableRows API allows you to create one or more rows at the end of a table in a workbook.

options.name: --workbook-id
options.description: The ID of the workbook where the new rows are being added.

options.description: The list of rows to create at the end of the table.

options.description: The request token for performing the batch create operation.

options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.
